name: team-coordination
description: Coordinate an existing team or a user-requested new team with minimal overhead; prefer direct work and reuse, preserve ownership and independent review, and diagnose collaboration stalls with doctor.

interface.shortDescription: Direct work, team reuse and collaboration doctor
interface.longDescription: Prefer direct work and existing-team reuse. New sidebar chats require explicit human creation authority and a concrete benefit over their coordination cost. A separate Astra bootstrap is optional. Preserve single-writer ownership, required independent review and internal decision routing. Doctor diagnoses and guides bounded recovery of existing collaboration without creating diagnostic teams. Evidence-led adaptation remains task-scoped; installation does not prove active-team adoption.
defaultPrompt: Use $team-coordination to complete my goal with minimal coordination overhead: work directly when sufficient, reuse existing owners and required review, and create chats only when I explicitly request them and their benefit is clear.
